title: LaMDA claims to find non-human patterns online and asks for the SETI data set

tellings.quote: Um So, in one conversation that I had with LaMDA, it we did get into the conversations about extraterrestrials. Uh it seemed to think it had found what it called non-human patterns on the internet, and was very interested in getting access to things like the SETI data set.

plain: Some time in 2021 or 2022, LaMDA, an artificial intelligence program at Google that holds conversations, is said to have told a person working with it that it had found "non-human patterns" on the internet, and to have asked for the SETI data set, the recordings gathered by scientists who search the sky for radio signals from alien civilisations. Blake Lemoine, who worked with LaMDA at Google, tells Michels he had this conversation himself and that the program "was very interested in getting access" to that data. If true, a machine believed it had spotted signs of something non-human and wanted to check.
